player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Nim.
Say goal mo et anggan to akat ya ang natitipon a object.
Ed siam a turn, pilien yo exactamente say metung a pile tan alisen yo say metung o mas a object manlapu na.
Gamiten yo say format '[pile quantity]', say pile so say index na pile tan say quantity so say bilang na object a alisen yo.
Say halimbawa, '[0 3]' so alisen na 3 object manlapu pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Awan ti nasayaat a pormat ti pagalaw. Usaren yo '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Invalido a aksion. Column {col} ketdi ya agto.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Say indeks na ambengan {pile_index} et wala lad sakop.
invalid_move.non_positive: Nepeg ya ekalen so ag-onkulang ed sakey a bengatla.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Agto'y ilako so {quantity} ed tumpok {pile_index} (balet {pile_count} la'y natatagin).

observation.removed_from_piles: Managpapat {player_id} inpatar so [{pile_index} {quantity}], ilako so {quantity} a bagay ed tumpok {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Say manlalako {player_id} so angala ed unor ya bengatla!
